params.body:
Step 3b, the last one in removing the Sanity layer.

## The Sanity client imitation goes
`store.client` imitated the Sanity client. It had createOrReplace, createIfNotExists, `patch(id).set().commit()`, delete, and `fetch()` with a GROQ string matched by substring (`query.includes('_type == "source"')`), and it routed writes by Sanity document types (`dailyInsight`, `culturalConcept`, `culturalTension`). Every caller was writing or listing sources, or editing one record from the dashboard. They now call functions named for that:

| was | now |
|---|---|
| `client.createOrReplace({_type: 'source', ...})` | `saveSource(doc)` |
| `client.createIfNotExists({_type: 'source', ...})` | `addSource(doc)` |
| `client.fetch('*[_type == "source" && active == false] ... order(_createdAt desc)[0..50]')` | `listSources({active: false, newestFirst: true, limit: 51})` |
| `client.patch(id).set(fields).commit()` | `updateRecord(id, fields)` |
| `client.delete(id)` | `deleteRecord(id)` |

- Callers moved: discover, ingest-drive, ingest-report, academic-follow, academic-venues and the server's `/store/patch|create|delete`.
- `/store/create` adds a source (the Sources page is its one caller), whatever `_type` it is sent.
- Gone: `writeDoc`, `tableForDoc`, `createDocIfNotExists`, `fetchQuery`, and the no-op `writeSignal`.

## Names
- `sourceToSanity` is now `sourceFromRow`, and a source has `createdAt` instead of `_createdAt`; the `reports` query answers the same way (the dashboard reads it in gentells-dashboard, linked below).
- `handleSanityQuery` is now `handleStoreQuery`.
- `promoteToSanity` is now `promoteSignals`: it flips a status in SQLite, and has pushed nothing anywhere since April.
- Log lines and comments that said something is written to or read from Sanity now say what happens.

What still mentions Sanity is history: comments that explain a past bug, and `bin/plain-ids.mjs`.

Tests: 953 pass. The source tests call the new functions, and the standard-stamp test calls `writeConcept`, `writePattern`, `writeTension` and `writeInsight` directly. Lint: 0 undefined names, and the unused count is unchanged.

Merge together with the dashboard PR (`createdAt` on the Reports page, no `_type` on create).
params.title: The Sanity client imitation goes; store functions named for what they do
